who-this-is-for.text: A runner operator who wants one persistent deployment instead of every run publishing scripts and booting a throwaway registry nothing else will see.

what-you-can-do.text: Deploy once from the joiner wallet, then attach every runner to the manifest. The sequence diagram shows deployment, manifest, mirror-checked attach, and journeys with no boot and no publish. Spellings stay exact; held spellings stop after a counted refusal.

what-you-see-when-it-is-refused.text: A second deploy against one manifest is refused. A mirror mismatch errors before funding. A held spelling ends in a counted phase-2 refusal. Fresh-registry rows say so and still use recorded scripts.

timely-windows-not-fixed-sleeps.text: A retract once arrived five minutes after its thirty-second window closed. Requests now live beside their rows, validity starts from a fresh chain tip, and runners poll for outputs instead of sleeping.

acceptance-from-the-shipped-issue-and-pr.text: Docs checks green but not binding the runners. Binding evidence: the shared-devnet attach gate with stable counts across all journeys, increased counts on the fresh control, accepted retracts on live-tip bounds, a demonstrated faulty counter repaired in the same history, and a twice-refusing deploy.

deviations.text: The published preprod record and the canonical deployment itself are deferred with the ticket left open, stated plainly in the shipped body. The retract repair goes beyond the ticket with a measured reason. The mirror travels per ruling. No question raised.

limits-of-this-slice.text: Public-network deposits and budgets are not established here; the later lifecycle-funding slice owns that repair. The identity encoding change arrives separately. Lean unchanged.
